accounting_connections_signed_in_complet.name: accounting_connections_signed_in_complete
accounting_connections_signed_in_complet.value: "accounting_connections"."refresh_token_encrypted" IS NULL OR ("accounting_connections"."accounts_server" IS NOT NULL AND "accounting_connections"."api_domain" IS NOT NULL AND "accounting_connections"."connected_at" IS NOT NULL)

accounting_connections_active_ready.name: accounting_connections_active_ready
accounting_connections_active_ready.value: "accounting_connections"."status" <> 'active' OR ("accounting_connections"."refresh_token_encrypted" IS NOT NULL AND "accounting_connections"."external_organization_id" IS NOT NULL)

accounting_connections_disconnected_hold.name: accounting_connections_disconnected_holds_nothing
accounting_connections_disconnected_hold.value: "accounting_connections"."status" <> 'disconnected' OR ("accounting_connections"."refresh_token_encrypted" IS NULL AND "accounting_connections"."connect_token_hash" IS NULL)

accounting_syncs_synced_complete.name: accounting_syncs_synced_complete
accounting_syncs_synced_complete.value: "accounting_syncs"."status" <> 'synced' OR ("accounting_syncs"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accounting_syncs"."synced_at" IS NOT NULL)

webauthn_challenges_confirmation_is_boun.name: webauthn_challenges_confirmation_is_bound
webauthn_challenges_confirmation_is_boun.value: "webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'register_passkey' OR ("webauthn_challenges"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "webauthn_challenges"."intent_hash" IS NOT NULL AND ("webauthn_challenges"."purpose" <> 'approve_payouts' OR "webauthn_challenges"."payout_ids" IS NOT NULL))

memberships_identity_check.name: memberships_identity_check
memberships_identity_check.value: ("memberships"."role" = 'accountant' AND "memberships"."email" IS NOT NULL) OR ("memberships"."role" <> 'accountant' AND "memberships"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

payees_details_have_changed_at.name: payees_details_have_changed_at
payees_details_have_changed_at.value: "payees"."method" IS NULL OR "payees"."method" = 'outside' OR "payees"."details_changed_at" IS NOT NULL

payees_no_details.name: payees_no_details
payees_no_details.value: ("payees"."method" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."method" <> 'outside') OR num_nonnulls("payees"."phone", "payees"."till_number", "payees"."paybill_number", "payees"."account_reference", "payees"."bank_code", "payees"."bank_account_number", "payees"."account_name", "payees"."usdc_address") = 0

payees_mpesa_phone_details.name: payees_mpesa_phone_details
payees_mpesa_phone_details.value: "payees"."method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'mpesa_phone' OR ("payees"."account_name" IS NOT NULL AND ("payees"."phone" IS NULL) = ("payees"."kind" = 'employee') AND ("payees"."phone" IS NULL OR "payees"."phone" ~ '^\+254[17][0-9]{8}$') AND num_nonnulls("payees"."till_number", "payees"."paybill_number", "payees"."account_reference", "payees"."bank_code", "payees"."bank_account_number", "payees"."usdc_address") = 0)

payees_mpesa_till_details.name: payees_mpesa_till_details
payees_mpesa_till_details.value: "payees"."method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'mpesa_till' OR ("payees"."account_name" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."till_number" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."till_number" ~ '^[0-9]{5,7}$' AND num_nonnulls("payees"."phone", "payees"."paybill_number", "payees"."account_reference", "payees"."bank_code", "payees"."bank_account_number", "payees"."usdc_address") = 0)

payees_mpesa_paybill_details.name: payees_mpesa_paybill_details
payees_mpesa_paybill_details.value: "payees"."method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'mpesa_paybill' OR ("payees"."account_name" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."paybill_number" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."paybill_number" ~ '^[0-9]{5,7}$' AND "payees"."account_reference" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("payees"."phone", "payees"."till_number", "payees"."bank_code", "payees"."bank_account_number", "payees"."usdc_address") = 0)

payees_bank_details.name: payees_bank_details
payees_bank_details.value: "payees"."method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'bank' OR ("payees"."account_name" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."bank_code" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."bank_account_number" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("payees"."phone", "payees"."till_number", "payees"."paybill_number", "payees"."account_reference", "payees"."usdc_address") = 0)

payees_usdc_details.name: payees_usdc_details
payees_usdc_details.value: "payees"."method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'usdc' OR ("payees"."usdc_address" IS NOT NULL AND "payees"."usdc_address" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$' AND num_nonnulls("payees"."phone", "payees"."till_number", "payees"."paybill_number", "payees"."account_reference", "payees"."bank_code", "payees"."bank_account_number", "payees"."account_name") = 0)

payouts_funding_is_complete.name: payouts_funding_is_complete
payouts_funding_is_complete.value: "payouts"."status" NOT IN ('funding', 'paying', 'paid') OR ("payouts"."amount_to_transfer_usdc" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."deposit_address" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."funding_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("payouts"."provider" <> 'paycrest' OR "payouts"."provider_order_id" IS NOT NULL))

payouts_approved_has_approver.name: payouts_approved_has_approver
payouts_approved_has_approver.value: "payouts"."status" = 'awaiting_approval' OR "payouts"."status" = 'failed' OR ("payouts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payouts"."approval_id" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_transactions_deposit_is_onchain.name: wallet_transactions_deposit_is_onchain
wallet_transactions_deposit_is_onchain.value: "wallet_transactions"."type" <> 'deposit' OR ("wallet_transactions"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_transactions"."log_index" IS NOT NULL AND "wallet_transactions"."block_number" IS NOT NULL)

wallets_active_is_complete.name: wallets_active_is_complete
wallets_active_is_complete.value: "wallets"."status" <> 'active' OR ("wallets"."privy_policy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "wallets"."privy_wallet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "wallets"."address" IS NOT NULL)
